modification_description: Deeper champion: 5th non-downsampling DilatedAttention encoder block (64->64 dilation=2) before bottleneck
Wider champion: doubled encoder channels (1->16->32->64->128 vs 1->8->16->32->64)
Intra-block residual shortcuts in all 4 encoder stages (same channels+dilations as champion)
SE channel attention after each bottleneck conv layer (2×SEBlock3D at 128ch) — same as champion otherwise
Exploration: replace MaxPool3d with learned stride-2 Conv3d+IN+ReLU downsampling (dilated+SE attention otherwise identical to champion)
CBAM spatial attention (channel SE + spatial attention map) on champion encoder blocks
GroupNorm (8 groups) replacing InstanceNorm3d in all encoder and bottleneck layers of champion
